run_make_solvable_files: run the script to find Waymo scenarios where agents must collide with road edges to reach their goal
run_is_file_valid: run is_file_valid to test if scenario files require agents to collide with road edges to achieve goals
run_parallel_validation: run the script with --parallel flag to split file validation across multiple processes for faster processing
run_train_data_validation: run the script with --datatype train to validate only training data scenarios for solvability
run_valid_data_validation: run the script with --datatype valid to validate only validation data scenarios for solvability
